summary: No published exact three-minus A6 formula was found, and a 590-block universal simple-channel orbit ansatz was ruled out exactly over two primes.
work_done: Searched primary literature and documented why arXiv:2606.28280 and the 2012 compact-Zakharov six-wave calculation do not contain the requested exact amplitude.
Specified a four-channel-orbit ansatz for H using degree-four cell-symmetric numerators over simple pair/triple propagators.
Delegated implementation to technician /root/technician and independently corrected/verified the target normalization, modular powers, orbit grouping, homogeneity, and Stage-B augmentation.
Tested 590 universal orbit features on 670 exact-GMP training points spanning 387 full sign signatures; both primes gave rank 166 versus augmented rank 167.
Independently reran 220 fresh exact points and reproduced the same two-prime rank jump with conservation and exact-to-modular checks passing.
next_steps: Test compatible double-propagator tree-orbit blocks 1/(h_S h_T) with symmetry-complete degree-six numerators.
Alternatively derive a genuinely new positive-part or geometric construction rather than adding more numerator monomials to the simple-channel class.
